subject: How to calculate manually cumulative probabilities for categorical responses

messages.author: c185bf1eab54b5fd
messages.subject: How to calculate manually cumulative probabilities for categorical responses
parts:
I need to calculate cumulative probabilities for categorical responses. How can I do that with lavaan?
I have read the example: http://www.personality-project.org/r/tutorials/summerschool.14/rosseel_sem_cat.pdf but cannot figure out how to calculate manually for the  whole sample. The example in the 2014 presentation calculate only with value from 0 to 10.
My model is:
ctrl.labor <- "
control_labor =~ lincome+lwh++mjob+pos
control_labor~ urbanrate+lhincome+spland_hec+owing+poor+manu_mine+uti+construction+lowser+hiser+lm1ac5+ltedu+ lf_prov14
lwh~lm1ac5+m1ac2+major+migrated+ttnt+married+manu_mine+uti+construction+lowser+hiser
lincome~m1ac2+major+migrated++ttnt+married+manu_mine+uti+construction+lowser+hiser
mjob+pos~lm1ac5+m1ac2+major+ttnt+married+manu_mine+uti+construction+lowser+hiser
lincome~~lwh
pos~~lwh
mjob~~lwh
pos~~lincome
"

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: How to calculate manually cumulative probabilities for categorical responses
parts: I need to calculate cumulative probabilities for categorical responses. How can I do that with lavaan?

You should write out the estimated regression equation for the outcome whose probability you want to calculate, then plug in the values you need.  Here is an example from a simpler model, but the same principles apply to your case, where your outcomes are predicted by both a common factor and exogenous predictors.

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lavaan/mG5Mjrf2jgo/0Q6IFgSUDAAJ
